title: Kenworth T Series heavy duty FUPS Compliant Road Train Bullbar #86
description: Kenworth T909 high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS 5 post Road Train Bullbar with Cow Catcher with 3 extra mini uprights and skirt. Special reinforced extra strong uprights that extend to lower bar. 88mm diameter pipe but optional 76mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Five post design ensures maximum protection to the bonnet and radiator. Minimum bonnet to upright clearance to all for maximum dimension combinations. Reversible aluminium road train signs with KW engraved Logo. Optional Dangerous Goods sign. Provision for front mudflaps. Heavy duty steel backing plate with polished aluminium tow plate. Fitted with dual bar lift assist springs. Additional heavy duty bonnet mounted driving light bar. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
